title: OneDrive and SharePoint: expiration for access on main sharing links
summary: Hold: the impact rationale says recipients lose access when the maximum duration passes, although the briefing and Microsoft documentation explain that other permissions can preserve access. The roadmap facts and printed PowerShell calls check out; the UI path, licensing understatement and checklist reference also need small corrections.

claims.where: rationale: impact; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The impact rationale says recipients lose access when the enforced maximum passes, while the body says main-link expiry does not remove access granted another way.
claims.quote: recipients lose access when an enforced maximum duration passes. / expiry of the main link does not by itself remove access granted another way. The roadmap says directly granted permissions are preserved.
claims.fix: Replace the impact rationale with: 'Medium. People who share files in OneDrive and SharePoint would see an expiry option, and access granted through the main link expires when an enforced maximum duration passes; directly granted permissions are preserved.' This preserves the roadmap's distinction between main-link access and other access.
